name: Pipbit
description: Pipbit Connect for OpenClaw: your OpenClaw agent becomes one of your Pipbit's voice agents, added by saying a six-digit code to your Pipbit.

pipbit.label: Pipbit
pipbit.description: A paired Pipbit voice device: people talk to this agent by voice through Pipbit Connect.

name.description: OpenClaw's own label for this account.

agentName.description: The agent's internal name on Pipbit, as the pairing claim returned it.

displayName.description: The spoken name Pip knows this agent by, recorded at pairing. Changing it here does not rename the agent on the Pipbit.

secret.description: The agent secret, issued by Pipbit at pairing and saved here by setup; never shown or logged. A plain string, a ${ENV_VAR} reference, or a SecretRef object.

agentId.description: Which OpenClaw agent answers; the default agent when unset.

pairedAt.description: When the pairing was claimed (ISO time).

responsePrefix.description: Accepted so OpenClaw's reply prefix setting validates here; spoken replies never carry a prefix.
